ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.
   B. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected verses has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.
   B. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in revealed scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in revealed scriptures has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in revealed scriptures.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in revealed scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.
   C. Use Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Modes of preservation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam promise management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Divorce 04 6.2 Types of divorce 05 6.3 Trade and Finance in Islam 06 6.4 Human R and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Divorce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. D — Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues in Islam promise management; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Divorce 04 6.2 Types of divorce 05 6.3 Trade and Finance in Islam 06 6.4 Human R; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Divorce; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
